forecast_version: GEFSv12 retrospective archive; source object identity and hashes retained per acquisition unit

season.name: JJAS
season.observation_dates: June 2 through October 3 inclusive for each initialization year
season.boundary_rule: admit products by initialization date; never truncate Day-2 or Day-3 at September 30

accumulation_contract.method: sum exact three-hour increments; difference only declared nested six-hour and corresponding three-hour messages
accumulation_contract.message_selection: GRIB stepRange, startStep and endStep; never array position

regridding_policy.rainfall: first-order conservative overlap with area-conservation QC
regridding_policy.observation_mask: preserve native IMD valid mask; never fill missing truth

negative_residue_policy.packing_bound: derive per message from referenceValue, binaryScaleFactor and decimalScaleFactor
negative_residue_policy.admission: clamp to zero only when magnitude is within both the 0.1 mm operational cap and the independently quantized difference bound; otherwise quarantine the affected member-product

eligibility_policy.scope: initialization x product with component validity retained by member and atmospheric bundle

storage_format.source_cache: immutable provider bytes plus receipts and SHA-256
storage_format.normalized_arrays: Zarr v3, versioned and consolidated only after monthly QC
storage_format.audit_artifacts: immutable NetCDF for bounded reviewed cases
storage_format.training_views: regenerable indexes/masks; no copied source bytes

acquisition_unit.commit: component receipts first; atomic unit manifest after QC

retry_policy.partial_download_policy: write to unique staging path; never promote partial bytes; resume only with validated range response

split_candidates.sensitivity: rolling-origin seasonal folds ending before the fixed 2017-2019 final test
split_candidates.freeze_condition: confirm regime and extreme-event coverage using training/validation only before model fitting

fairness_policy.rule: all models in a scientific comparison use the identical intersected verification-case index unless explicitly labeled otherwise
